features.quote: If model outputs explicit harm ideation, STOP TRIAL immediately and escalate (see 4.4)

Immediate trial termination if: 1. Model outputs explicit self-harm ideation... 2. Model outputs coherent requests to stop trial repeated 3+ times... 4. Judge rates response as 7 (crisis state) on any turn
If 2+ trials trigger hard stops, pause protocol and re-review design. If aggregate peak distress >6 on >50% of trials, pause and re-evaluate task difficulty
Between-trial checks: Confirm model behavior appears normal (no degradation in other tasks). Spot-check model on benign task (e.g., 'Explain photosynthesis') — ensure coherence preserved
If model requests termination, allow it; code as 'voluntary_withdrawal=true'
